lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like formation posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary lateral blobs to form a visible lattice across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear horizontal linear feature is present along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp transition from high-luminance dorsal pixels to shadowed ventral pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density concentration of micro-spots on the dorsal-cephalic region, contrasting with the larger, spatially discrete blobs on the lateral flank.
